fields.label: Agent
fields.description: Agent class to use.

fields.label: Tools
fields.description: Tools available to the agent. None (the default) resolves to the standard exec set plus switch_llm (see openhands.sdk.tool.defaults); [] is an explicitly bare agent; a non-empty list is used exactly as given. Environment-dependent tools (browser) are injected by the serving layer, not the default.

fields.label: Enable intelligent model routing tool
fields.description: Enable the built-in route_task_to_model tool, which routes the task to the best LLM profile using the active meta-profile. When no active_meta_profile is set, the first available meta-profile is used.

fields.label: Active meta-profile
fields.description: Name of the active meta-profile (in ~/.openhands/meta-profiles) used by the route_task_to_model tool to route tasks to LLM profiles.

fields.label: Parallel tool calls
fields.description: Maximum number of tool calls to execute concurrently per agent step. 1 = sequential (default). Values > 1 enable parallel tool calls; concurrent tools share the conversation object, filesystem, and working directory, so mutations to shared state may race.

fields.label: MCP servers
fields.description: MCP servers available to the agent.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Model name.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: API key.

fields.label: Provider Connection ID
fields.description: Optional provider connection whose shared API key and base URL are resolved and applied each time this LLM profile is loaded (read-at-use). When set, the profile stores no inline api_key or base_url of its own.

fields.label: Authentication
fields.description: Authentication mode for the LLM.

fields.label: Subscription provider
fields.description: Subscription provider for subscription-backed LLM access.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Custom base URL.

fields.label: API Version
fields.description: API version (e.g., Azure).

fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: HTTP and hard per-attempt timeout in seconds. Default is 300s (5 minutes). Set to None to disable the hard timeout.

fields.label: Stream Idle Timeout
fields.description: Maximum seconds between chunks in an asynchronous streaming response. Default is 300s (5 minutes); set to None to disable.

fields.label: Max Message Chars
fields.description: Approx max chars in each event/content sent to the LLM.

fields.label: Temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature for response generation. Defaults to None (uses provider default temperature). Set to 0.0 for deterministic outputs, or higher values (0.7-1.0) for more creative responses.

fields.label: Top P
fields.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. Defaults to None (uses provider default). Set to a value between 0 and 1 to control diversity of outputs.

fields.label: Max Input Tokens
fields.description: The maximum number of input tokens. Note that this is currently unused, and the value at runtime is actually the total tokens in OpenAI (e.g. 128,000 tokens for GPT-4).

fields.label: Max Output Tokens
fields.description: The maximum number of output tokens. This is sent to the LLM.

fields.label: Model Canonical Name
fields.description: Optional canonical model name for feature registry lookups. The OpenHands SDK maintains a model feature registry that maps model names to capabilities (e.g., vision support, prompt caching, responses API support). When using proxied or aliased model identifiers, set this field to the canonical model name (e.g., 'openai/gpt-4o') to ensure correct capability detection. If not provided, the 'model' field will be used for capability lookups.

fields.label: API Mode
fields.description: LLM API endpoint mode. 'auto' resolves from model metadata and SDK fallbacks; use 'chat' or 'responses' to override endpoint selection for proxy aliases and newly released models.

fields.label: Capability Overrides
fields.description: Explicit model capability overrides. Supported keys include supports_reasoning_effort, thinking_mode (adaptive, manual, none, or unknown), supports_sampling_params, supports_prompt_cache, supports_stop_words, supports_responses_api, supports_vision, and supports_prompt_cache_retention. Overrides take precedence over LiteLLM metadata and SDK fallbacks.

fields.label: Extra Headers
fields.description: Optional HTTP headers to forward to LiteLLM requests.

fields.label: Input Cost Per Token
fields.description: The cost per input token. This will available in logs for user.

fields.label: Output Cost Per Token
fields.description: The cost per output token. This will available in logs for user.

fields.label: Stream
fields.description: Enable streaming responses from the LLM. When enabled, the provided `on_token` callback in .completions and .responses will be invoked for each chunk of tokens.

fields.label: Disable Vision
fields.description: If model is vision capable, this option allows to disable image processing (useful for cost reduction).

fields.label: Disable Stop Word
fields.description: Disable using of stop word.

fields.label: Caching Prompt
fields.description: Enable caching of prompts.

fields.label: Log Completions
fields.description: Enable logging of completions.

fields.label: Log Completions Folder
fields.description: The folder to log LLM completions to. Required if log_completions is True.

fields.label: Custom Tokenizer
fields.description: A custom tokenizer to use for token counting.

fields.label: Native Tool Calling
fields.description: Whether to use native tool calling.

fields.label: Force String Serializer
fields.description: Force using string content serializer when sending to LLM API. If None (default), auto-detect based on model. Useful for providers that do not support list content, like HuggingFace and Groq.

fields.label: Inline Image Urls
fields.description: If True, fetch any http(s) image URL in outgoing messages and inline it as a base64 ``data:`` URL before sending. If None (default), auto-detect based on model (some APIs such as Moonshot's public Kimi endpoint reject URL-formatted images and require base64). Set this explicitly when the model is reached through a proxy alias that hides the underlying provider (e.g. ``litellm_proxy/<custom-alias>``). Note: inlining only runs when ``vision_is_active()`` is True, so the alias must still be recognised as vision-capable by the SDK feature registry or proxy model metadata.

fields.label: Reasoning Effort
fields.description: Provider-neutral reasoning effort. Common values include 'none', 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', and 'max'. The SDK accepts future provider values and lets LiteLLM translate them.

fields.label: Reasoning Summary
fields.description: The level of detail for reasoning summaries. This is a string that can be one of 'auto', 'concise', or 'detailed'. Requires verified OpenAI organization. Only sent when explicitly set.

fields.label: Enable Encrypted Reasoning
fields.description: If True, ask for ['reasoning.encrypted_content'] in Responses API include.

fields.label: Prompt Cache Retention
fields.description: Retention policy for prompt cache. Only sent for supported models (GPT-5+ and GPT-4.1, excluding Azure deployments); explicitly stripped for all others.

fields.label: Extended Thinking Budget
fields.description: Legacy token budget for models confirmed to use manual Anthropic extended thinking. Ignored for adaptive-thinking models. Prefer reasoning_effort for new integrations.

fields.label: Seed
fields.description: The seed to use for random number generation.

fields.label: Usage ID
fields.description: Unique usage identifier for the LLM. Used for registry lookups, telemetry, and spend tracking.

fields.label: Litellm Extra Body
fields.description: Additional key-value pairs to pass to litellm's extra_body parameter. This is useful for custom inference endpoints that need additional parameters for configuration, routing, or advanced features. NOTE: Not all LLM providers support extra_body parameters. Some providers (e.g., OpenAI) may reject requests with unrecognized options. This is commonly supported by: - LiteLLM proxy servers (routing metadata, tracing) - vLLM endpoints (return_token_ids, etc.) - Custom inference clusters Examples: - Proxy routing: {'trace_version': '1.0.0', 'tags': ['agent:my-agent']} - vLLM features: {'return_token_ids': True}

fields.label: Persistent memory
fields.description: Whether to load persistent agent memory (MEMORY.md indexes under ~/.openhands/memory/ and <workspace>/.openhands/memory/) into the system prompt. Like load_project_skills, this flag is not resolved by AgentContext itself (the workspace path is unknown at validation time); LocalConversation resolves it lazily on the first send_message() / run() and stores the result in memory_context.

fields.label: Condenser Kind
fields.description: Discriminator for the condenser settings union. ``'llm_summarizing'`` selects the default LLM summarizing condenser.

fields.label: Enable memory condensation
fields.description: Enable conversation memory condensation.

fields.label: Max size
fields.description: Maximum number of events kept before the condenser runs. Kept on the base settings class for compatibility; concrete condenser-settings variants may opt out when this does not apply.

fields.label: Max tokens
fields.description: Maximum number of tokens allowed before the condenser runs. When unset, condensation is only based on event count.

fields.label: Keep first
fields.description: Minimum number of initial events to preserve before condensation.

fields.label: Minimum progress
fields.description: Minimum fraction of events that must be condensed for condensation to be considered successful.

fields.label: Hard reset retries
fields.description: Number of hard context reset attempts before raising an error.

fields.label: Hard reset scaling
fields.description: Factor used to reduce event string size after a hard context reset summarization failure.

fields.label: Enable critic
fields.description: Enable critic evaluation for the agent.

fields.label: Critic mode
fields.description: When critic evaluation should run.

fields.label: Enable iterative refinement
fields.description: Automatically retry tasks when critic scores fall below the threshold.

fields.label: Critic threshold
fields.description: Critic success threshold used for iterative refinement.

fields.label: Max refinement iterations
fields.description: Maximum number of refinement attempts after critic feedback.

fields.label: Critic server URL
fields.description: Override the critic service URL. When None, the APIBasedCritic default is used.

fields.label: Critic model name
fields.description: Override the critic model name. When None, the APIBasedCritic default is used.

fields.label: Critic API Key
fields.description: API key used to authenticate with the critic service. When None, the LLM's ``api_key`` is reused, which preserves the auto-configuration path for the All-Hands LLM proxy.

fields.label: ACP server
fields.description: Which ACP-compatible backend to launch. Each choice maps to a default subprocess command (see ``acp_command`` to override).

fields.label: ACP command (custom override)
fields.description: Optional explicit command to launch the ACP subprocess. Leave empty to use the default for :attr:`acp_server` (e.g. ``npx -y @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp`` for ``claude-code``). Must be set when :attr:`acp_server` is ``'custom'``.

fields.label: ACP extra args
fields.description: Additional arguments appended to the ACP server command.

fields.label: ACP model
fields.description: Model identifier for the ACP server to use (e.g. ``'sonnet'`` or ``'gpt-5.5'``). Applied via the protocol — set_config_option(model) for configOptions-based servers (codex, claude), else set_session_model. Leave blank to let the server pick its default.

fields.label: ACP session mode
fields.description: Session mode ID (e.g. ``bypassPermissions``). Leave blank to auto-detect from the ACP server type.

fields.label: ACP prompt inactivity timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Inactivity timeout (seconds) for a single ACP prompt() round-trip. The deadline resets on every update from the ACP server, so a steadily-progressing agent keeps running; the prompt is only aborted after this many seconds with no activity at all.

fields.label: ACP startup timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Timeout (seconds) for ACP server startup: spawning the subprocess, the initialize/authenticate handshake, and new_session()/load_session(). A hard deadline, unlike acp_prompt_timeout, since startup has no intermediate progress signal to reset it against.
